content.query:
select 
* 
from 
om.om_task_error_dtl oted
left join
om.om_tasks ot
on
oted.task_name=ot.task_name
where 
ot.source_code='DEP' and process_date='''2024-01-26'''  
and create_datetime >= '''2024-01-26'''
order by create_datetime desc

select * from om.om_tasks where SOURCE_CODE = '' task_name like '%BRANCH%'

select DISTINCT SOURCE_CODE from om.om_tasks
